name: field
title: Field
description: A labelled form field: a label above, an input that focuses and types, helper text below, and a second filled field in the same group.
useWhen: A form needs consistent label, control and helper-text spacing, with one field being filled in.
A sign-up walkthrough shows several fields stacked.
avoidWhen: A single bare field is enough: use input.
A multi-step flow with navigation: use signup-flow.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Description
variables.description: Helper text under the animated field.
variables.default: We will never share your email.

variables.label: Value
variables.description: Text that types into the field.

variables.label: Second label
variables.description: Label of the second, already filled field.

variables.label: Group gap
variables.description: Space between the two fields in design pixels.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Playback speed of the interaction. Above 1 it finishes early and holds the last state.

variables.label: Transparent background
variables.description: Skip the theme background so the control sits on your own scene.
